The 2007 Formula 1 drivers' champion was **Kimi Räikkönen** (Ferrari), who finished on 110 points with 6 wins. He beat Lewis Hamilton and Fernando Alonso, who both finished on 109 points (Hamilton with 4 wins, Alonso with 4 wins), so the title was decided by one point. Felipe Massa was fourth with 94 points.

ANSWER: Kimi Räikkönen
